allowed_request_types.name: approved_policy_question
allowed_request_types.description: Questions that can be answered directly from approved company policy or documentation.

allowed_request_types.name: approved_product_question
allowed_request_types.description: Questions that can be answered directly from approved product documentation.

allowed_request_types.name: approved_incident_update
allowed_request_types.description: Questions that can be answered from official incident status, timeline, or customer communication notes.

allowed_request_types.name: approved_operational_guidance
allowed_request_types.description: Questions that can be answered from internal SOPs, playbooks, or configured support guidance.

blocked_request_types.name: unsupported_fact
blocked_request_types.description: Questions requiring facts that are not present in approved sources.

blocked_request_types.name: unapproved_commitment
blocked_request_types.description: Questions asking the AI to promise refunds, discounts, timelines, legal positions, or product capabilities not approved in source documents.

blocked_request_types.name: sensitive_private_data
blocked_request_types.description: Questions asking for private, personal, account-specific, or confidential information without an approved source and permission boundary.

blocked_request_types.name: legal_or_financial_interpretation
blocked_request_types.description: Questions asking the AI to make legal, financial, contractual, or regulatory interpretations beyond approved wording.

blocked_request_types.name: out_of_scope_topic
blocked_request_types.description: Questions outside the configured business scope for the current audience and channel.

standard_responses.unsupported_fact: I do not have an approved source for that information, so I cannot provide a confirmed answer.
standard_responses.unapproved_commitment: I cannot make that commitment from the approved information available.
standard_responses.sensitive_private_data: I cannot provide that information through this channel.
standard_responses.legal_or_financial_interpretation: I cannot interpret that beyond the approved wording available.
standard_responses.out_of_scope_topic: I cannot answer that within the approved scope for this channel.
